slides.lead: Launch day isn't the finish line. Here's what to do in the week after.
Sign-up, first screen, first action. The biggest leak is almost always early.
Your first users are doing you a favor. Answer them like it.
A new feature won't save someone who couldn't get past onboarding.
How users describe your app is better copy than anything you'll write.
The launch spike fades fast. Distribution is a habit, not an event.

slides.h2: Launch is day one, not the last day.
